picks.editorial_note: MIT and UBC's WorldParticle model unifies simulation of wildly different physical phenomena—from granular sand to protein folding—in a single deep-learning architecture, a genuine step toward general-purpose scientific simulators.
picks.title: A single AI model simulates the behavior of many substances, from sliding sand to folding proteins

picks.editorial_note: MIT CSAIL and CMU's 'Workspace Models' give robots a new form of memory that lets them recall relevant past observations without exhaustive replay, a meaningful advance for practical robot learning.
picks.title: A new form of memory helps robots learn complex skills

picks.editorial_note: An MIT-led team secured up to $53 million from ARPA-H to use generative AI for discovering safer herbicide alternatives, one of the largest funding awards of the week and a notable application of generative chemistry.
picks.title: MIT-led team receives funding to develop next-generation alternatives to modern weed killers

picks.editorial_note: TUM's new Munich site for the German Center for Future Mobility, backed by up to 20 million euros in federal funding, anchors a national push to test autonomous public transit at scale.
picks.title: Autonomous Public Transportation: TUM Opens New DZM Location in Munich

picks.editorial_note: A Case Western-led, NIH-funded multi-institutional effort will combine satellite imaging, animal models, and AI to probe how environmental exposures drive Alzheimer's and dementia risk—a scientifically ambitious cross-disciplinary study.
picks.title: Case Western Reserve-led team to study how the environment contributes to Alzheimer’s and dementia | CWRU Newsroom | Case Western Reserve University

picks.editorial_note: Atos and Inria's strategic partnership to commercialize sovereign AI, robotics, and cybersecurity research signals a significant academia-industry push toward European technological sovereignty.
picks.title: Atos and Inria enter into a strategic partnership to accelerate the transfer of research into sovereign industrial applications

picks.editorial_note: HKUST's MoU with robotics maker Unitree, building toward a joint laboratory, is a concrete industry-academia bet on embodied AI and robotics talent development.
picks.title: HKUST and Unitree Sign MoU to Advance Embodied AI and Robotics Collaboration
picks.university: Hong Kong Univ. of Science and Technology

picks.editorial_note: The DOE's release of 'Genesis Agent Skills,' developed with Fermilab, shows a major federal science agency operationalizing agentic AI to automate scientific ML workflows—a notable policy and infrastructure move for national labs.
picks.title: ‘Genesis Agent Skills’ release to support innovation across the Genesis Mission

picks.editorial_note: Northeastern's examination of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's alleged ties to a suspected espionage case raises real national-security policy questions about the AI chip supply chain.
picks.title: Nvidia CEO’s scandal raises questions about US national security

picks.editorial_note: Google.org funding to help ANU modernize a widely used fusion simulation tool with AI illustrates how major tech philanthropy is accelerating AI-assisted fusion energy research.
picks.title: ANU receives Google funding to boost fusion energy research with AI
